object:scale mail.visualDescription: A gray-olive torso armor has short sleeves, pale vertical scale rows on its front, a red belt, and split lower panels.
object:scale mail.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies scale mail as iron body armor built from overlapping scales.
object:scale mail.modelBrief: Make a wearable gray-olive scale cuirass with short shoulder plates and a red waist belt; keep the front rows legible.

object:studded leather armor.visualDescription: A dark red-brown leather suit has studded chest bands, pointed shoulders, and a short split skirt.
object:studded leather armor.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies studded leather armor as a leather body suit reinforced with studs.
object:studded leather armor.modelBrief: Build dark russet leather armor with small pale studs across the torso, broad shoulders, and skirt flaps.

object:ring mail.visualDescription: A brown tunic has round pale metal rings down the torso and skirt, with olive sleeves and hem.
object:ring mail.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies ring mail as iron body armor with metal rings attached to a backing.
object:ring mail.modelBrief: Make a waist-length ring-mail tunic with visible circular ring rows and olive-brown cloth beneath.

object:crude ring mail / orcish ring mai.visualDescription: A crude rust-brown tunic has dark ring rows, broad sleeves, and a split skirt.
object:crude ring mail / orcish ring mai.wikiDescription: The wiki says orcish ring mail is iron armor whose unidentified appearance is crude ring mail.
object:crude ring mail / orcish ring mai.modelBrief: Create a rough asymmetric ring-mail garment with dark rings over reddish leather or cloth; preserve the coarse look.

object:leather armor.visualDescription: A reddish-brown leather cuirass has wide shoulder flaps, dark waist bands, and a short lower skirt.
object:leather armor.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies leather armor as a leather body garment offering modest protection.
object:leather armor.modelBrief: Build a fitted leather torso piece with layered shoulder and waist panels in warm brown.

object:leather jacket.visualDescription: A long brown jacket hangs open at the center, with sleeves and dark red seams near the hem.
object:leather jacket.wikiDescription: The wiki describes the leather jacket as leather body armor rather than a cloak.
object:leather jacket.modelBrief: Model a wearable knee-length leather jacket with defined sleeves, collar, and open front.

object:Hawaiian shirt.visualDescription: A short-sleeved red shirt has bold yellow-orange flowerlike patches and a loose straight hem.
object:Hawaiian shirt.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the Hawaiian shirt as a cloth shirt, mechanically close to the T-shirt.
object:Hawaiian shirt.modelBrief: Make a loose bright red short-sleeved shirt with simplified yellow tropical motifs, without adding armor plates.

object:T-shirt.visualDescription: A cream T-shirt has dark brown sleeves and a central brown-red face or figure print.
object:T-shirt.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the T-shirt as a cloth shirt with a printed slogan or design.
object:T-shirt.modelBrief: Build a plain wearable short-sleeved cream shirt with dark sleeves and a small pixel-style chest print.

object:mummy wrapping.visualDescription: A pale beige strip of mummy wrapping lies in a tangled, looped heap with dark gaps.
object:mummy wrapping.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies mummy wrapping as a cloth cloak often left by mummies and useful as an outer covering.
object:mummy wrapping.modelBrief: Model a loose bundled strip of dirty linen with several curled folds, rather than a fully wrapped person.

object:faded pall / elven cloak.visualDescription: A deep green pall hangs in a rounded triangular shape with a dark center and muted gold upper edge.
object:faded pall / elven cloak.wikiDescription: The wiki says the elven cloak is a cloth cloak appearing as a faded pall when unidentified.
object:faded pall / elven cloak.modelBrief: Make a softly draped green cloak with faint olive trim and a deep central opening.

object:coarse mantelet / orcish cloak.visualDescription: A gray-blue coarse cloak has broad rounded shoulders, dark central gap, and uneven lower hem.
object:coarse mantelet / orcish cloak.wikiDescription: The wiki says the orcish cloak appears as a coarse mantelet when unidentified.
object:coarse mantelet / orcish cloak.modelBrief: Build a thick rough shoulder cloak in blue-gray cloth, with ragged edges and an open front.

object:hooded cloak / dwarvish cloak.visualDescription: A golden-brown hooded cloak has a rounded hood, dark face opening, and two long draped sides.
object:hooded cloak / dwarvish cloak.wikiDescription: The wiki says the dwarvish cloak appears as a hooded cloak when unidentified.
object:hooded cloak / dwarvish cloak.modelBrief: Make a compact ochre cloak with deep hood and heavy front drapes; keep the face opening empty.
